title: nan
authors: Madokoro H.; Yamamoto S.; Watanabe K.; Nishiguchi M.; Nix S.; Woo H.; Sato K.
key_contribution: Presents an acoustic drone localization method using a cross-shaped 32-microphone array with delay-and-sum beamforming for GNSS-denied areas, validated on an outdoor benchmark dataset.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
